note.title: High-scoring structures
note.overview: This lesson contains 52 enabled questions. It teaches High-scoring structures through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for High-scoring structures.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Choose connectives by purpose: sequence, contrast, time, reaction or comment.
ce qui est/était comments on the preceding idea.
après avoir + participle links two actions by the same person.
A connective must join complete, meaningful ideas.
Do not list linkers without using them accurately in writing.

workedExamples.prompt: Give one taught French option for this purpose: sequence.
workedExamples.why: The source groups « d’abord, puis, ensuite, après, finalement » under sequence. One complete option is enough.

workedExamples.prompt: Give one taught French option for this purpose: contrast.
workedExamples.why: The source groups « mais, cependant, pourtant, en revanche » under contrast. One complete option is enough.

workedExamples.prompt: Give one taught French option for this purpose: time.
workedExamples.answer: le matin, le soir, à… heures, tout de suite, assez tôt, trop tard
workedExamples.why: The source groups « le matin, le soir, à… heures, tout de suite, assez tôt, trop tard » under time. One complete option is enough.

workedExamples.prompt: Give one taught French option for this purpose: reaction.
workedExamples.why: The source groups « heureusement, malheureusement » under reaction. One complete option is enough.

workedExamples.prompt: Give one taught French option for this purpose: relative phrase.
workedExamples.answer: ce qui est… / ce qui était…
workedExamples.why: The source groups « ce qui est… / ce qui était… » under relative phrase. One complete option is enough.

commonMistakes: Choosing a linker with the wrong job.
Using ce qui without a complete preceding idea.
A small article or ending can change the grammar even when the main vocabulary is recognisable.
Do not choose a familiar linker with a different job.
A grammatically possible linker can still be wrong if it expresses the wrong relationship.
